relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Zong Rinpoche (1905-1984 AD) was a Gelug Lama and disciple of the third Trijang Rinpoche

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He went to Lhasa in 1916 when he was eleven years old to study Buddhadharma as presented in Je Tsongkhapa's tradition at Ganden Shartse Monastery ... After graduating as the highest-ranking Lharampa Geshe at the age of only twenty-five in 1929

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: After graduating as the highest-ranking Lharampa Geshe at the age of only twenty-five in 1929, he moved on to the Tantric College of Gyuto, where he also successfully completed his examinations.

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: he served nine years as Abbot of Ganden Shartse College beginning in 1937 ... Zong Rinpoche resigned from his seat in 1946

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1965, Zong Rinpoche became the director of the newly formed Tibetan Schools Teachers Training Program in Mussoorie

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.object: Central Institute of Tibetan Higher Studies
relations.evidence: In 1967, he was appointed as the first principal of the new Central Institute of Tibetan Higher Studies at Sarnath, Varanasi, India. After retiring from public life in 1971

relations.subject: Geshe Lhundub Sopa
relations.evidence: He was the teacher of Geshe Lhundub Sopa, Lama Thubten Yeshe, Lama Zopa Rinpoche, Tsem Rinpoche and Geshe Tsultim Gyeltsen
